author: Inside Edition
description: Prosecutors say a doctor deliberately drove his car off a cliff in a bid to kill his entire family. The doctor, his wife and two children, aged 7 and 4, survived. Dr. Dharmesh Patel was charged with three counts of attempted murder. Patel was diagnosed with major depressive disorder and mental health experts said his driving off the cliff was caused by a psychotic break. Despite objections by prosecutors, after he completed the mental health diversion program, all charges have been dismissed against the 45-year-old California radiologist and that has generated an uproar.
title: Charges Dismissed For Doctor Who Drove Tesla Off Cliff To Kill Family

author: Inside Edition
description: A 6-year-old was playing with his Nerf toy outside his house when something frightening erupted. A black bear charged towards the boy but Bella the husky was on the case. The dog chased the animal away from the child. The boy's dad, who was loading up the car, could not believe what just happened. Inside Edition spoke with Jeff Tazzara and his son who was saved by his faithful dog, Colton.
title: Faithful Husky Saves 6-Year-Old Boy From Charging Black Bear

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops in Maryland say a man who burglarized a business had the audacity to report someone had stolen his vehicle. The theft occurred while he allegedly was busy breaking into a phone store. Howard County Police say he called 911 to report his truck was stolen, but just a few minutes earlier police were responding to a break-in at a Verizon retailer across the street.  When the responding officer noticed the man was bleeding, officials said he put two and two together. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Calls 911 After Vehicle Was Stolen While Cops Say He Was Robbing A Store

author: Inside Edition
description: A veteran news anchor went public after saying she was scammed out of her life savings. Alex Delgado worked at KSEE in Fresno for 22 years. After she retired, she said she put years of savings into a banking and investment app called Robinhood. Delgado says she got a text from someone she thought was from Robinhood telling her there was suspicious activity on her account and to call a number. Over two days, she says the scammer, who turned out not to be from Robinhood, gained her trust and convinced her to transfer her entire account.  Robinhood says they are aware that financial scams are on the rise and for that reason they have implemented safeguards in place to monitor, report, and disrupt fraudulent activity.
title: Veteran News Anchor Says She Was Scammed Out Of Her Life Savings

author: Inside Edition
description: The life of Philip Pohle, a facilities worker for Ohio Dept. of Natural Resources, changed forever after a tree he was moving fell on him and his tractor. A GoFundMe page has been setup to help pay for expenses: www.gofundme.com/f/support-phillips-long-road-to-recovery
title: Ohio Man Survives 'Internal Decapitation' #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A bit of hope after a devastating attack. A cat was pulled from the rubble of an apartment building in Kyiv more than a day after Russian missiles rained down on the city. This wasn't a stray hiding out. The cat named Bonia had a family. The woman who claimed the animal said its owner was living with family since her home was destroyed. She also said the family suffered the loss of two members. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cat Found Alive In Rubble Of Building Destroyed By Russian Missiles

author: Inside Edition
description: He's the Norwegian striker who is absolutely dominating the World Cup. Erling Haaland is also making headlines for his unusual and abundant diet, which includes raw milk. The controversial food choice has health experts worrying that this will cause more people to seek it out. The FDA defines raw milk as milk from cows, sheep or goats that hasn't been pasteurized. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Warnings About Raw Milk Risks After Erling Haaland Says Its In His Diet
